WalletProfile.title: Wallet Profile
WalletProfile.description: Represents a connected wallet and its digital reputation score/butterfly details.

address.description: The unique public key / address of the wallet.

connectedAt.description: The timestamp when the wallet profile was first created.

lastSeen.description: The timestamp of the last activity seen.

verifiedNfts.description: List of verified NFTs associated with this profile.

detectedAlignment.description: Alignment detected based on reputation scan.

detectedSeed.description: Seed used for generating the customized butterfly.

isEvolved.description: Whether the butterfly has been evolved by the user.

selectedBadge.description: The current badge selected for display on the overlay.

customOverlayImg.description: Base64 or reference URL of the custom overlay image.

customOverlayName.description: Optional name displayed on the custom overlay.

isCustomApplied.description: Whether custom overlay styling has been applied.

/wallets/{walletId}.description: Main collection storing reputation data and customization settings for each scanned wallet address.
